title: Open the explorer home page
user_must: open one page that shows every explorer section: blocks, transactions, accounts, validators, contracts and search
gate: E2: home page must show blocks, tx, accounts, validators, contracts and search

title: View the latest blocks
user_must: see the latest canonical blocks with height and hash, exactly as the chain indexer holds them
gate: E2: explorer must read blocks from the indexer

title: Inspect one block by height or by hash
user_must: open the same block page whether the search term is its height or its hash
gate: E2: block lookup by height and hash must agree

title: Look up a transaction and see its status
user_must: see whether a transaction is confirmed, finalized, orphaned or unknown, derived from the canonical chain
gate: E2: tx status must follow the canonical chain

title: See balance and history
user_must: look up an account balance and past transactions without trusting a third party
gate: E2: account history must match the chain

title: Follow a transaction to finality
user_must: watch a transaction reach finality with one unambiguous status word
gate: E2: transaction finality must be unambiguous

title: Inspect validators and consensus health
user_must: see the validator set, participation and finality health of the network
gate: E2: validator view must show consensus health

title: Search for anything
user_must: type a height, hash, address or contract address and land on the right object
gate: E2: search must find blocks, txs, accounts and contracts

title: Read a contract's verified source
user_must: open a contract page and read the verified source that matches the deployed code hash
gate: E2: contract page must show the verified source

title: Trust the page over the API
user_must: see the same numbers in the rendered page as the JSON API returns
gate: E2: the web UI must render the same data as the API
